title: Akiyama Mizuki — Encouraged By Kindness〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: It's great that Shiho was able to find a present for her sister she was happy with.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm really glad that we could help her since she put so much thought into it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, wanna head over to the next shop...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
If you don't mind, I'd like to use the restroom first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, I'll start organizing all our stuff on that bench over there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Now then... Where do I begin?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Let's see... I can put all the accessories in one of the smaller bags, and for this big one...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Alright, that should do it!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Has this accessory shop always been here?
It wasn't here the last time I came. Maybe it's new.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Sis probably won't be back for a little bit, so I might go take a quick peek♪)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, this ribbon's so cute!
It's velvet, and in a modest color too, so I bet it'd look great on Sis.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, they have them in different colors!
This one's bright pink! That's totally up my alley!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Shiho and Shizuku's brooches are in different colors...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And Sis and I used to wear matching ribbons when I was little.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I know...
I could make this my present for Sis, and I could get the same one in a different color!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's no telling when we'll get to see each other next, so I should take this opportunity to show my support for her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(While I'm at it, I wanna make it a surprise...
I'll go buy them now on the down-low♪)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see, where's the checkout counter...
A few days later
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, the ribbons are all set!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Not bad if I do say so myself.
These pieces are stitched together well, including the lace bit I worked so hard on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki, mind if I come in?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, come on in!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I've been having trouble getting everything to fit into my suitcase. Can you lend me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, your flight's tomorrow. You're still packing...? Are you sure you're gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on... This feels like déjà vu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh...
I asked you the same thing the last time I left.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And you're still terrible at packing your bags.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: No no, I got all of my personal belongings to fit. It's all the gifts from our family that won't!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, that sounds like bragging.
To be fair, Mom and Dad did give you a bunch of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of gifts...
I have something for you, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Huh? For me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
Here it is, just for you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh wow...! This ribbon's such a beautiful color!
And this lace bit's really nice...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe... I actually put that part on myself!
I did what I could to make sure it'd look good on you, Sis♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Wait, you made this?!
That's incredible! I never would've guessed!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
This lace... I can't get enough of it!
You know me too well, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heehee. Don't I♪
By the way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I've got the same one!
I added some frills to mine to make it look more cutesy♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember how Shiho got matching brooches for her and Shizuku at that New Year's sale?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seeing her do that made me want to get something for you and me, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Mizuki! I'm so unbelievably happy! I promise to cherish this forever!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's the opposite of last time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember that ribbon you gave me before?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That ribbon made it seem like you were always by my side, even during the hardest times.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: It did...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, Sis...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember those matching scrunchies you made for everyone in N25? You said it's your way of wishing that we'll be together forever.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I thought these ribbons could be the same thing, but for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So that we'll never be apart, no matter where we are!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
This ribbon...
It'll always remind me that I have your support. It'll help me overcome anything that comes my way!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, Sis?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's both keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
